citations.passage:
Decision: cancel the Kestrel CRM experiment, agreed at the go/no-go (m-006)
— the studio's client count does not justify the maintenance surface. Export
the trial data and tear down (s-009).

Go/no-go on Kestrel after the two-week trial: Theo's prototype works, but
the ops load fell on Lorna alone and no one can own the tool going forward —

judge.rationale: The answer correctly identifies the Lorna-only ops burden, lack of sustainable ownership, and insufficient client volume, but adds the unsupported claim that Theo needed to return to Wayfare and Beacon Grid and omits the reference's successful prototype and go/no-go, cancellation, export, and teardown sequence.
